_comment: Project-scoped MCP servers for the Factoidal repo. Loaded by Claude Code at session start; requires one-time per-project user approval. Future contributors can pre-approve via `claude mcp` or by accepting the prompt on first session.

fstar._comment: F* IDE-protocol bridge from FStarLang/fstar-mcp. The wrapper activates the fstar opam switch (so fstar.exe is on PATH) before exec'ing the fstar-mcp binary. The binary lives at ~/.cargo/bin/fstar-mcp; .claude/hooks/session-start.sh installs it on a fresh sandbox.
